_comment: Pre-registered forward test, 2026-10-01 (check-in #1). STAMP ONLY - nothing reads this to pick or stake. Scored automatically by scripts/feature-clv-report.js on forward games only. Every feature stays at weight 0 throughout.
name: MLB candidate bundle (sides)
hypothesis: When the zero-weight MLB candidates, turned to the side we picked, favour our pick, our locked price beats the close.

window.why: Mid-April so 7/14-day form windows hold this season's games, not last season's. Regular season only; the 2026 postseason is too few games and a different regime.

test.statistic: Pearson r between the frozen composite and game-level CLV (moneyline + spread picks averaged per game), lock-time vectors only
test.composite: sum over features of weight x z-score, z-scored within the forward sample
test.power_note: In-sample r was ~0.23 (max) and the split-half out-of-sample r 0.16-0.20. Expect shrinkage. At r=0.10, 400 games gives t~2.0; at r=0.15, t~3.0.
test.scored_once: Scored once, at targetGames. Not read early, not extended if it misses.

if_passed: Earns a second, staked-at-zero design step: choose ONE weight for the composite and pre-register THAT. Still no weight change from this result alone.
if_failed: Drop the bundle. Do not re-slice it for a subset that would have passed.

_provenance.sample: MLB v2_clv, clv_basis=novig, game_date 2026-09-11..2026-09-30, moneyline+spread, lock-time vectors, 207 games
_provenance.weights_are: each feature's in-sample game-level r with CLV, rounded to 3 dp
_provenance.robustness: unchanged after controlling for the picked side's market price (p=0.009); split-half out-of-sample composite r=0.195 (t=1.94) and 0.159 (t=1.67); partial r vs live-model edge ~0.20 / 0.12; totals placebo p=0.94
_provenance.main_threat: All 207 games are from the last three weeks of the regular season (clinched teams resting starters, expanded rosters). The effect may be September-only. Only the 2027 window can say.
